verdict.rationale: Metronome is API-first, so it can be automated headlessly. It offers bearer-token auth, official SDKs in five languages, idempotent retries, paginated list endpoints and a published OpenAPI spec, which together support scripted, non-interactive use. However, the pack has no evidence of a CLI, CI/CD integration guidance, or infrastructure-as-code tooling, and API tokens are created through the Metronome app UI. Missing for 10: official CLI or CI-runner tooling, documented CI/automation workflows, programmatic token provisioning, independent hands-on corroboration.
